overview: A boot enchantment. Caught running or falling in the rain, you get a fleeting ice platform underfoot, so you can sprint across open ground without slowing down or taking fall damage.

2.0.2: Ice puts back the block it covered, in the dimension it was laid.
A platform over a lake no longer leaves a hole in it.
The book turns up in loot chests, and librarians can offer rain walking.
2.0.1: The enchantment says what it does in its own description.
2.0.0: The Rain Walker enchantment and the ice it lays.
A librarian mentions the book only while it is actually raining.
